scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or if there's any update? Also, I'd like to know the interest rate and total costs associated with the loan.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. The interest rate is 6.125% and the total loan costs are $15,087.99.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Thank you for the information. I also noticed that my loan term is 372 months. Can you confirm if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? Additionally, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan does not have any high-cost or negative amortization flags. It has been sold to another type of purchaser.

dialogue.user: Thank you for clarifying that. I appreciate the information. That's all I needed to know. <Satisfied> The agent was helpful and provided clear answers to my questions.
